question: With which sport are Vijay Amritraj and Anand Amritraj associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawn Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijay Amritraj** and **Anand Amritraj **are **associated **with **Lawn Tennis**.

 
 
• **Vijay Amritraj **and his **brothers**, **Anand Amritraj **and **Ashok Amritraj**, were **among **the **first Indians **to **play **in **top-flight international tour tennis**.
 
• In **1976**, the **brothers**, **Vijay **and **Anand**, were **semi-finalists** in the **Wimbledon men's doubles**.
 
• **Amritraj **was the **captain **of the **Indian Davis Cup **for **much **of the** late 1970s** and **1980s**, helping India reach the finals in 1974 and 1987.
 
• For **almost two decades**, **Vijay Amritraj **was one of the **most famous tennis players **in the **world **and was the **top tennis player **in **Asia **for **14 straight years**.
